column1: # manifests/vendor-repos.tsv -- the complete reviewed apt-SOURCE allowlist.
# Every source line (.list) and deb822 source a scanned image references must match a row
# here EXACTLY on (scheme, host, path, suite). There is NO host-only exception and NO '*'
# suite wildcard: a host being known is not enough, and a suite name alone is never proof.
# 'approved=yes' rows are reviewed. 'pending' rows are real sources we have NOT approved;
# the gate fails closed on them until the operator signs off (do not invent approval).
# Columns (TAB): kind, scheme, host, path, suite, approved, vendor, note
# kind: debian-pin (BUILD snapshot; path contains the literal <pin>), debian-live (runtime),
